text:
Predicates:
Private(x) ::: x is a private university.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League university.
Research(x) ::: x is a research university.
Move(x, y) ::: x moved to location y.
Value(x, y) ::: x's value is y.
OrganizedInto(x, y) ::: x is organized into y.
College(x) ::: x is a college.
School(x) ::: x is a school.
Residential(x) ::: x is a residential college.
Premises:
Private(YaleUniversity) ∧ IvyLeague(YaleUniversity) ∧ Research(YaleUniversity) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
Move(YaleUniversity, NewHaven, 1716) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven in 1716.
Value(Endowment(YaleUniversity), $42.3billion) ::: Yale university's endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
OrganizedInto(YaleUniversity, {ResidentialColleges, YaleGraduateSchoolOfArtsAndSciences, TwelveProfessionalSchools}) ::: Yale University has been organized into 27 constituent colleges and schools: the residential colleges, the Yale Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, and twelve professional schools.
Conclusion:
Move(University, NewHaven) ::: A private Ivy League research university moved to New Haven.
